scope: Bounded-route feasibility for AVI MPEG-4 Part 2 video to 3GP packet copy with incompatible AVI MP3 audio explicitly excluded.
conversionClass: compressed-video packet copy, not decode/re-encode and not extension renaming
converterBoundary: Native FFmpeg was used only for deterministic feasibility and independent validation. Public acceptance still requires conversion through the production browser worker and published Wasm engine.

audio.disposition: must be explicitly excluded because the certified 3GP packet-copy profile accepts AAC audio only

requiredProductionGates: browser conversion through the production worker and candidate Wasm engine
independent structure, complete-decode, and exact video-packet validation
complete Chromium process-tree incremental private memory at or below 250 MiB
bounded reads, writes, queues, and one pending operation
success, cancellation, forced-write-failure, and cleanup recovery
registry, UI, README, TESTED, evidence manifest, and engine manifest agreement
decision: Proceed with a production-browser candidate; keep avi-to-3gp unpublished until every production gate passes.
